label: WITHHOLD_1: every history in the root's choice cell maps to a world where it does not give x
definition: WithholdsByCell F world g x k: every history in the choice cell of g represented by k, at the selected moment of a STIT branching frame, maps to a world where g does not give x being. It is agentive control over the cell (Cstit, definition c54f0922), not one history of nonproduction. It says nothing about accessibility of the mapped worlds or about g's presence there. Example: a partition whose cell for a refusal maps only to worlds without the gift. Non-example: a cell containing one history with the gift and one without.
note: Analyst sense (#2090, #2103). rootsHaveWithholdingCells_iff shows the cell premise 0dd78706 is this sense for each actual root and grounded actual concretum (Iff.rfl). Distinct from WITHHOLD_2 (0772c968): passage to sense 2 needs the admissibility premise 46a468b2. A source stating that the first cause's choice includes withholding a particular effect would source it.
